method: per-currency pillar drivers -1/0/+1 from the morning engine reads; positioning scored by the single contrarian rule from the TFF hedge-fund cut (crowded long >=90th = -1, crowded short <=10th = +1, else 0)
note: Weekend (Sunday 2am) read, 2026-10-18. Scores: policy = own-bank stance vs counterparty (gap favoring the other side is negative); positioning = contrarian only (stretched longs -1, stretched shorts +1, never a supportive base). Graham correction folded: waiver suspends duties outright, no Oct-18 bite.

October locked as a hold (~85%) into the Oct 27-28 blackout; December the debate (~74% hike).
